name: Domonique's subway accident
context: The heart of the episode, which opens with a trigger warning. Domonique says that after years of chronic pain and complex PTSD, a ruptured disc and being handed more pills instead of care, she attempted suicide and lost her right arm and right leg. She tells it as a story of healing and hope - the recording falls a day before its seventh anniversary

name: New York
context: Domonique started going back and forth to New York around 2008 and found a scene in transition, she says - and a welcome: new parties wanted her as host and costume maker

name: James St. James
context: Host; he says everyone told him to find Ryan Burke and Domonique when he was shooting Transformations in New York, and he followed her healing on Instagram

name: Domonique Echeverria
context: Guest. Designer, it girl, party host, healer and public speaker from the San Francisco Bay Area who became one of the faces of New York nightlife in the twenty-tens. She tells the story of the subway accident that cost her her right arm and right leg, and of how she healed and now helps others heal through her site Universal Mother

name: San Francisco
context: Where Domonique grew up and came up in the drag, new wave, glam rock and burlesque scenes; she says many of those friends were pushed out of the city later

name: Ryan Burke
context: Club kid makeup artist and Domonique's roommate; James knew him in LA and says the two of them were the epicentre of the scene then

name: Los Angeles
context: Where others fled, where James first knew Ryan Burke - and where Domonique lives now, very much in the leather scene

name: Domonique's mother
context: Filmed the first time Domonique stood again and helped her post from the hospital

name: Universal Mother
context: The free healing resource site Domonique started after her accident: a community board with mental health resources and hotlines, a healers page with about 19 people experienced in trauma work, and a wisdom page. She says she built it so nobody has to wait around hoping the system takes pity on them

name: Fenton Bailey
context: Co-host; asks about the New York scene when she arrived, and says her story is painful to tell but helpful to people

name: Randy Barbato
context: Co-host; asks what she would say to anyone in a crisis moment - and owns up that his own fetish is other people's fetishes

name: David Glamamore
context: Designer and drag mother - an old, old friend from New York, James says; Domonique calls him and Juanita MORE! iconic and her first drag parents

name: Instagram
context: Where James looked up her looks before Transformations, and where she later shared her recovery, first steps and all

name: COVID-19 pandemic
context: Domonique says she lost friends in those years, and was glad she had trained in healing work, long-distance Reiki among it

name: Broken Greek statue
context: Her return to nightlife, as James remembers the picture: painted white and cracked like a classical statue missing an arm and a leg. James says that was when he knew she was going to be okay - and her friends were already asking about machine-gun arms, swords and tentacles
fashion: White body paint cracked like marble

name: Juanita MORE!
context: San Francisco drag queen and party host; Domonique says she started out in the city's drag scene as one of Juanita's and Glamamore's children

name: Tenderloin
context: Domonique calls herself a Tenderloin and Mission child who ran around the bars at 17

name: Zana Bayne
context: Leather designer and Domonique's lifeline in New York - they started out as sewing sisters; Domonique says Zana has made pieces for Beyoncé, Cardi B and plenty more

name: Susanne Bartsch
context: Domonique worked with her a little at the start in New York; later she names Susanne with Lady Fag as mothers of the scene who helped raise money for her

name: Dylan Monroe
context: An artist friend working with Susanne Bartsch then, who has since died; James remembers him as gorgeous

name: Transformations (James St. James)
context: James's makeover series: filming ten episodes in New York, he kept asking who the new kids were and everyone said Ryan and Domonique. She blew into the hotel room like a tornado with ten people, they broke into the minibar, and James says he said no to her many times

name: Domonique's mythology looks
heard: Mexican religion ... medieval and Roman ... Greek goddess
context: The looks James found on Instagram before Transformations, designed and worn by Domonique herself: Mexican religious imagery, medieval and Roman touches, a Greek goddess - all sorts of mythology, very original and very over the top

name: Body, booty and hair at the Maritime
heard: body, adi, adi, the booty, booty, booty, the hair, the hair
context: Domonique blowing into the Transformations hotel room like a tornado, as James remembers it: body, booty, hair and ten friends in tow

name: Medical industrial complex
context: Domonique's name for the system that passed her around - she says queer people especially get handed on carelessly, and that it pushed her spirit to dive deep into healing

name: Benefit nights for Domonique
context: James remembers the benefits at the clubs; Domonique says with a GoFundMe they raised around $30,000, which went on her first year of bills, therapy and healing

name: Lady Fag
context: Party promoter; with Susanne Bartsch, a mother of the scene who helped raise money for Domonique, she says

name: Alma (curandera)
context: The curandera who healed Domonique at the powwow. Domonique says Alma told her she had to learn to walk again and live, because she was one of their daughters - the moment, Fenton notes, she decided to live

name: Suicide and Crisis Lifeline (988)
context: The US crisis line James reads out on the show: call or text 988

name: The Trevor Project
context: James recommends it for LGBTQIA+ young people at risk; Universal Mother links to it too

name: World of Wonder (WOW)
context: Fenton and Randy's company, as James says in the intro

name: Drag scene sewing commissions
heard: as soon as all of them heard that I had a sewing machine
context: She was at fashion school, and once the drag queens and showgirls heard she had a sewing machine they kept her busy with projects - she became the go-to for outfits, James says

name: Aunt Charlie's Lounge
context: Tenderloin drag bar Domonique went to as a teenager

name: Mission District
context: The other half of her San Francisco teenage stomping ground

name: The Stud
context: San Francisco queer bar on her teenage rounds

name: The Gangway
context: The Tenderloin's old gay bar, another of her haunts at 17

name: Beyoncé
context: One of Zana Bayne's famous clients, as Domonique tells it

name: Cardi B
context: Another, Domonique says

name: Katie Storm
context: A friend who had an in with the uptown crowd when Domonique arrived in New York

name: Facebook
context: Part of the tech wave Domonique says pushed artists out of San Francisco

name: Brooklyn
context: Where some of her San Francisco friends fled when the city got too expensive

name: Maritime Hotel
context: Where the Transformations shoot turned into a party, as Domonique remembers it

name: Henry De La Paz
context: A hairdresser friend Domonique thanks by name: she says he and a friend reached people they knew high up at the hospital, and that the queer web got her out - not a lawyer

name: Out (magazine)
context: Domonique says friends in the media writing about her in Out helped keep her from getting stuck in the system

name: GoFundMe
context: Part of the fundraising after her accident

name: Dr. Claire O'Neill
context: The chiropractor Domonique credits with resetting her bones - the first doctor, she says, who took the time to explain what had happened to her body

name: Domonique's father
context: Brought her to the powwow before she could walk again

name: BAAITS Two-Spirit Powwow
heard: the Bates to Spirit Pow Wow
context: Before she could walk, her father took her to the powwow, where a curandera named Alma gave her a soul retrieval healing - in February 2016, a month out of hospital, she says

name: Crisis Text Line
context: Or text 741741, James adds

name: YouTube
context: The video on her site's wisdom page about why queer people matter to evolution

name: Human Genome Project
context: Part of the video's argument, as Domonique retells it, that queer people go out into the world and bring back what they learn to the family

name: Leather scene
heard: the leather scene here in Los Angeles
context: James says Domonique is very much in it now and counsels a lot of the fetish kids; her own fetish, she says, is being adored

name: Domonique's on-camera look (S03E07)
context: Long brown hair under a circlet of hanging crystal prisms with a moonstone at the brow, red lips, a galaxy-print top and layers of gold medallion necklaces, at home among trailing plants, a sunburst mirror and a round brass mirror
fashion: Crystal prism circlet, galaxy-print top, gold medallions

name: James's on-camera look (S03E07)
context: Bald head, black rectangular glasses and a magenta shirt with a tie neck under a black cardigan, in front of his floor-to-ceiling bookshelves
fashion: Magenta tie-neck shirt, black cardigan, black glasses

name: Fenton's on-camera look (S03E07)
context: Round light-framed glasses and a grey cardigan over a grey T-shirt, between bookshelves and 70s ochre flower-pattern wallpaper with rust curtains behind

name: Randy's on-camera look (S03E07)
context: Dark flat cap, rectangular glasses and a red and navy plaid flannel shirt over a black T-shirt, in front of shelves of framed photos and a Holy Terror poster
